cases.counterfactual_program:
(rule!
 (lambda (g)
  (let* ([completed g]
         [parts (filter (lambda (part) #t) (objects completed 0))]
         [score (lambda (part) (obj-size part))]
         [chosen (if (empty? parts) '() (let ([target (apply max (map score parts))]) (filter (lambda (part) (= (score part) target)) parts)))]
         [selected (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)])
                             ([part (in-list chosen)])
                      (for/fold ([painted out]) ([p (in-list (obj-cells part))])
                        (paint-cells painted (list p) (cell-at completed (first p) (second p)))))])
    (overlay selected (transpose selected)))))

intermediate_value.authored_interpretation: Component descriptions are reviewer-authored. The native helper independently executes actual and wrong-order final labels.

intermediate: The completed grid and its same-color four-connected components with their occupied cell areas.
step_a: Complete main-diagonal reflection using the canonical overlay of the transpose.
step_b: Keep every completed component tied for the selected largest or smallest area and erase other foreground cells.
why_b_depends_on_a: Reflection joins separated source fragments and changes relative component areas; selecting original components and reflecting afterward gives different final cells.
